mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_tag (order_id, merchant_id, tag_name, tag_color, create_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{merchantId}, #{tagName}, #{tagColor}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM order_tag WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND tag_name = #{tagName}
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id as orderId, merchant_id as merchantId, tag_name as tagName, tag_color as tagColor, create_time as createTime FROM order_tag WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
